title: Former Intel packaging chief Navid Shahriari joins MediaTek as senior vice president
gist: MediaTek hired former Intel EVP Navid Shahriari, who oversaw Intel's back-end process, packaging/test and chiplet strategy, as SVP effective November 9 to lead advanced process, yield, testing and packaging and deepen TSMC collaboration. It is MediaTek's second major advanced-packaging talent move this year.

insights.claim: MediaTek recruited former Intel Executive Vice President Navid Shahriari as Senior Vice President effective November 9, reporting to President and COO Joe Chen.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Intel loses a senior packaging leader to a fabless rival.

insights.claim: Shahriari has 37 years of experience in semiconductor design engineering and advanced packaging and previously oversaw Intel's back-end process operations, packaging and testing, and chiplet integration strategy.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Brings direct chiplet and back-end know-how to MediaTek.

insights.claim: Shahriari will lead teams covering advanced process and yield and advanced testing and packaging.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Signals MediaTek is building in-house depth in packaging and yield, not just design.

insights.claim: A core mission is to deepen collaboration with supply chain partners including TSMC to help MediaTek advance AI and high-performance computing products.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: MediaTek's AI/HPC ambitions depend on securing advanced packaging capacity and co-development with TSMC.

insights.claim: This is MediaTek's second major talent move in advanced packaging, after recruiting former TSMC R&D VP Yu Chen-hua as an advisor in May this year.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: A pattern of hiring packaging expertise suggests advanced packaging is a strategic priority and constraint for MediaTek.
